Üldlaulupidu: the Estonian National Song Festival
column3: Le Premier Festival de la Chanson Estonienne

column2: In the summer of 1869 in Tartu (Dorpat), over 800 singers and musicians gathered for the first nationwide song festival. Organizing this celebration of choral culture and folklore crystallizes the national awakening and bolsters national pride.
